name: Jalen Chuang
biography: Jalen Chuang is a PhD student at the Hardware Security Lab at Georgia Tech. Jalen's research spans software fuzzing, CPU microarchitectural side-channels, and now focuses on trusted execution environments. Outside of research, Jalen is a regular CTF player and 2-time DEFCON CTF finalist.
